response.sql: WITH by_name AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS driver_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(driver_count) AS avg_count FROM by_name) SELECT AVG(b.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(b.driver_count) AS avg_driver_count, AVG(b.driver_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess_count FROM by_name AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE b.driver_count > o.avg_count;
